description: This file defines a service for aggregating Large Language Model (LLM) usage costs by agent name. It includes functions for resolving collection names, building MongoDB aggregation pipelines for different schema shapes, performing in-database aggregation, and fallback in-application aggregation when database pipelines fail. The main exported function is getLlmCostByAgent(), which returns total costs per agent, handling various cost and agent field variations.

methods.name: resolveCollectionCandidates()
methods.description: Determines candidate collection names based on environment variables and defaults, prioritizing 'llm-costs' and related collections.

methods.name: buildFlatAgentCostPipeline()
methods.description: Constructs a MongoDB aggregation pipeline to process flat schema documents with various agent and cost fields, normalizing and summing costs per agent.

methods.name: buildAgentsArrayPipeline()
methods.description: Constructs a MongoDB aggregation pipeline to process nested Agents array schema documents, normalizing agent names and summing costs.

methods.name: aggregateAgentsInApp(documents = [])
methods.description: Performs in-process aggregation on an array of documents with Agents array shape, grouping by normalized agent name and summing costs.

methods.name: getLlmCostByAgent()
methods.description: Main exported function that attempts to aggregate LLM costs by agent directly via database pipelines; fallback to in-app aggregation if pipelines fail.
